prompt: I’m redesigning our checkout page and want it to work better for people using screen readers and keyboards. What frontend changes should we make during implementation?
Can you help me audit a finished website for WCAG issues before we launch? I need a practical testing checklist and tools to verify fixes.
We’re building an AI assistant that can plan tasks, call tools, and recover from failures. Help me think through the agent architecture.
I have a new chatbot feature and want to test whether it behaves badly under tricky prompts or unexpected user inputs. How should I evaluate it?
Our company has messy event data coming from several apps. I need a clean pipeline and models so analysts can trust the metrics.
I’m making an Android app and want a modern UI with Jetpack Compose instead of old XML layouts. Can you help structure the screens?
Our team inherited an Angular app that needs new components, cleaner state handling, and better maintainability. Where should we start?
Need to design an API between our mobile client and backend. What’s the best way to define contracts, versioning, and error responses?
Can you review the security risks in a web application before we put it into production? I’m worried about common attack paths.
I need to choose encryption and key management approaches for a service that stores sensitive customer data. What should we use?
We’re scaling a product from a prototype into a real platform. Help me map out the technical architecture and major tradeoffs.
I recorded vocals and guitar at home but the mix sounds flat. What steps should I take to clean it up and make it sound professional?
We have users, teams, and different permission levels in our SaaS app. How should we design access control safely?
Our startup needs to deploy a backend on AWS with databases, storage, and monitoring. What services and setup would you recommend?
My company uses Microsoft tools and wants to move an application into Azure. Can you help plan the cloud setup?
I need help designing the server side of an app with APIs, databases, background jobs, and reliable deployment patterns.
I’m experimenting with Bun and Deno instead of Node. What are the differences and how should I structure a project using them?
Leadership wants a clear argument for whether we should build this feature. Help me analyze costs, benefits, risks, and expected return.
I’m working on a performance-sensitive C++ service and need advice on memory, concurrency, and low-level design choices.
Our builds are slow and releases are manual. Can you help us create a better CI/CD workflow with automated testing and deployments?
We have workloads spread across AWS accounts and I need a review of IAM, network exposure, encryption, logging, and cloud misconfig risk—not an app code review.
I’m adding a bytecode VM to our little language; help design lowering, instruction dispatch, stack frames, and runtime error behavior.
The warehouse camera feed needs to locate pallets and track them frame to frame; help me choose the CV pipeline and evaluation metrics.
This process hangs once every few thousand jobs and TSAN points at two worker threads. Can you chase the race/deadlock instead of treating it like a network outage?
Our Docker image is huge and the service behaves differently inside the container. Tighten the build, layers, runtime user, signals, and image contract; Kubernetes itself is out of scope.
The settings flow has vague validation copy and dead-end errors. Rewrite the messages and recovery actions so users know what happened and what to do next.
Can you go through this vendor agreement and flag renewal traps, liability language, termination rights, obligations, and clauses we should negotiate?
This .NET 9 service has messy DI, async code, and EF Core boundaries. Help refactor it using current C#/.NET patterns without changing behavior.
Enterprise customers get through onboarding but usage dies a month later. Build a success plan around adoption, health signals, outcomes, renewals, and escalation.
Here’s a CSV of support volume, response time, plan, and churn. Analyze what changed, quantify the main relationships, and tell me what the data actually supports.
Our nightly ingest sometimes duplicates records and silently skips late files. Redesign the ETL flow for idempotency, checkpoints, schema drift, retries, and backfills.
I have retention by cohort, plan, and signup month; what chart design will make the comparison honest and readable without turning this into a whole product UI redesign?
A query that used to take 80 ms now takes 9 seconds as the table grew. Inspect the plan, indexes, statistics, locks, and data shape before proposing a fix.
After yesterday’s refactor this command exits successfully but writes the wrong file. Reproduce it, isolate the cause, and explain the evidence before changing code.
Our desktop client is Tauri + Rust with a webview frontend. Add native file-open behavior and make the IPC/lifecycle handling correct on macOS and Windows.
The client and API keep breaking each other even though unit tests pass. Add deterministic contract checks for request/response schemas, error cases, and compatibility.
This parser failure looks random, but I want a fixed seed/input and a minimal replay that reproduces the exact bad state every time before we touch the implementation.
New engineers spend half a day getting this repo running and our CLI errors are cryptic. Improve the setup, feedback loops, commands, docs, and paved path.
We’re splitting a stateful service across regions. Work through partition ownership, consistency, retries, idempotency, failure modes, and cross-region recovery.
A checkout request sometimes stalls across API, queue, and payment workers. Use traces/log correlation to find where the distributed request is actually failing.
Turn these rough implementation notes into a clear design document with assumptions, decisions, diagrams-to-add, risks, and a reader-friendly structure.
Our CDN keeps serving stale API JSON after deploys. Work out the cache key, Cache-Control behavior, revalidation, purge path, and what the edge is really doing.
Password-reset mail is accepted by our provider but Gmail delivery tanked this week. Diagnose authentication, reputation, bounces, suppressions, content, and inbox evidence.
Review this connected sensor’s secure boot, debug-port lockout, firmware signing, key storage, update rollback, and physical attacker assumptions.
The STM32 firmware misses samples whenever DMA and an ISR overlap. Help fix the driver/state-machine timing and prove it on the target board.
We have a tiny 128×64 device display with three buttons and no touchscreen. Design the menu, focus/state behavior, error recovery, and readable status feedback for that hardware.
We need embeddings for multilingual product search. Compare model/task conditioning, normalization, dimensionality, batching, migration compatibility, and how to evaluate the representation.
Orders fan out to inventory, billing, and email through events. Define event contracts, ownership, ordering, idempotency, retries, DLQs, and replay semantics.
I have five pages of project detail; turn it into a one-page update for the exec team with the decision, business impact, material risk, and asks up front.

A randomized trial comparing two maintenance procedures has finished. Analyze treatment effects, uncertainty, blocking, heterogeneous effects, protocol deviations, and whether the causal evidence supports the operational conclusion.
Before we launch this pricing change, design an A/B test: unit of assignment, sample sizing, metrics, guardrails, exposure, stopping rules, and rollout decision.
I just got an unfamiliar dataset with 80 columns. Explore distributions, missingness, strange values, relationships, segments, and hypotheses before we lock an analysis plan.
Please verify whether this product claim is actually true today. I want primary sources, dates, contradictions, and a clear separation between facts and inference.
Add bulk archive to the existing project using its current patterns, including the UI action, backend behavior, error states, and tests. No architecture rewrite.
Build a three-year driver-based model for bookings, revenue, headcount, gross margin, cash burn, and downside/base/upside cases, with auditable assumptions.
We have labeled support conversations and want to know whether to fine-tune a model. Design the dataset split, training setup, eval gates, leakage checks, and promotion criteria.
Cloud spend jumped 35% with no matching traffic increase. Reconcile billing data, allocation, unit cost, waste/commitments, and which savings are actually realizable.
Implement the client-side behavior for this app screen—state, data loading, forms, responsiveness, loading/error states, and tests—using the repo’s existing frontend stack.
The feature is supposedly finished. Verify every stated behavior against the running product, including invalid inputs and recovery, and give me a pass/fail evidence table.
Prototype the core loop for a small action game: movement, enemy interactions, scoring, restart/death flow, deterministic update behavior, and a playable verification path.

The gameplay works, but the HUD, aiming reticle, world-space prompts, controller focus, camera-safe placement, and pause/menu transitions are confusing. Redesign those interface interactions without changing game mechanics.
We’re moving a data/API workload onto GCP. Choose the right project/IAM/network/compute/storage setup and show how to verify the actual Google Cloud configuration.
This Go service has leaky goroutines, awkward error handling, and flaky context cancellation. Refactor it idiomatically and prove the lifecycle behavior.
A CUDA kernel is slower than the CPU path and occasionally gives different answers. Profile transfers, occupancy, memory access, synchronization, and numeric correctness on the actual GPU.
Our GraphQL API is getting N+1 queries and clients depend on fields we want to change. Fix resolver/data-loader behavior and plan schema evolution without breaking consumers.
We need to improve activation after signup. Instrument the funnel, identify the biggest drop, propose a shippable product experiment, and define how we’ll measure lift.
Two services talk over gRPC and we need to evolve the protobuf messages safely. Work through field compatibility, deadlines, status errors, streaming behavior, and generated-client contracts.
The board only crashes after several minutes under real sensors; logs stop before the fault. Use registers, traces, timing, power/reset evidence, and a reproducible hardware loop to isolate it.
Design the REST semantics for creating and retrying payments: methods, status codes, idempotency, conditional updates, pagination, caching, and error bodies.

Users can technically finish this workflow, but the whole experience feels fragmented across discovery, setup, errors, and recovery. Review the end-to-end human journey and coordinate the right UX disciplines.
Create a repeatable prompt/iteration workflow for generating consistent product illustrations, including composition, style constraints, reference use, artifact review, and version tracking.
The design is settled. Make the requested change in this repo, preserve existing patterns, handle the edge cases you find, and verify the actual result.
This library needs an embedded job scheduler and state engine that runs inside the host process—no daemon and no network service. Design its lifecycle, concurrency, persistence boundary, and API.
Production errors just spiked and checkout is failing right now. Triage impact, stabilize safely, coordinate evidence/owners, test mitigations, and keep a timeline for the incident handoff.
Our admin console grew to 70 settings and nobody can find anything. Redesign the grouping, labels, navigation hierarchy, cross-links, and findability before touching visual styling.
Audit the host/network/runtime boundary for this deployment: exposed services, segmentation, OS hardening, secrets access, ingress/egress, privileged execution, and recovery controls.
Write a setup and recovery guide a new teammate can actually follow: prerequisites, exact sequence, checkpoints, common failures, rollback, and how to know each step worked.
Our happy-path integration tests pass, but I want to prove behavior when the dependency times out, returns partial data, rate-limits, duplicates a callback, or recovers mid-request.
Wire this app to the vendor API using the repo’s existing client patterns: auth, retries, pagination, webhook reconciliation, idempotency, error mapping, and sandbox verification.
Design the behavior of this multi-step editor: selection, keyboard/mouse actions, state transitions, undo, destructive confirmation, interruptions, and recovery. Visual polish can come later.
We have a working prototype and five target users. Build a task-based usability test, observe where they fail or hesitate, separate severity from preference, and retest the changes.
Build this iPhone settings flow in SwiftUI with correct navigation, state ownership, async loading, accessibility, previews/tests, and current Apple platform behavior.
This Java service has GC pauses and brittle concurrency around a shared cache. Diagnose it using the actual JVM/runtime settings and refactor with current Java patterns.
Clean up this Kotlin coroutine pipeline—structured concurrency, cancellation, nullability, sealed results, and tests—without turning it into an Android UI task.
This deployment rolls out but pods flap and disruption drains too much capacity. Inspect probes, requests/limits, rollout strategy, PDBs, scheduling, events, and controller state in the cluster.
Review the security boundary of this embedded scripting runtime: sandbox escapes, unsafe FFI, module loading, resource limits, serialization, and untrusted code execution.
A Linux host intermittently loses a mounted service after reboot. Trace systemd ordering, mounts, permissions, logs, kernel/userspace state, and make the fix persistent on this distro.
What does the peer-reviewed literature say about this intervention? Search systematically, separate study designs and publication status, assess quality/bias, and synthesize where results disagree.
Build the LLM feature behind this support tool: provider/model boundary, structured outputs, tool calls, retries, streaming, prompt/version handling, observability, and failure UX.
We have two prompt/model variants for the same assistant. Design a real eval set with deterministic checks where possible, blind judging where needed, failure categories, and a promotion threshold.
Turn this background engine into a machine-local daemon with IPC, process lifecycle, locking, restart/recovery, permissions, and a stable local client contract—no network API.

Research the current competitive landscape for this product category: named competitors, positioning, pricing, recent launches, customer evidence, market facts, and source dates. Don’t turn it into our strategy yet.
Given our product, customer evidence, and competitor map, choose which segment/problem we should compete for, what position to own, and what tradeoffs that implies.
Build the go-to-market communication plan for this launch: audience, message, channels, campaign sequence, measurement, and what we should not claim.
We need to move from the old service/database contract to the new one without a flag day. Plan coexistence, backfill, compatibility, progressive cutover, rollback, and completion evidence.
Evaluate this classifier against the deployment population: split design, leakage, class imbalance, thresholds, calibration, subgroup performance, uncertainty, and a release gate.
Set up the path from trained model to production with immutable data/model lineage, registry/versioning, deployment, feature freshness, monitoring, rollback, and controlled promotion.
Our MongoDB workload needs a schema/index redesign for this query pattern and write volume. Check document shape, indexes, transactions/consistency, migration, and explain evidence.
Plan and verify this MySQL schema/index change under production load, including locking, online DDL behavior, replication impact, rollback, and query plans.
Design this desktop/mobile-native workflow around platform navigation, focus, system conventions, accessibility, lifecycle interruptions, and real device/window behavior—not browser semantics.
Build this backend as a separately deployed network service with an authenticated API, timeouts, connection handling, retries/idempotency, health, shutdown, and compatibility guarantees.
One office/VPN path can reach the service and another can’t. Trace DNS, address family, routes, MTU, TCP/TLS, firewall/NAT, and packet evidence end to end.
This is a Next.js App Router app. Fix the server/client boundary, route data loading, caching/revalidation, metadata, and deployment behavior using the version actually installed.
The Node process leaks handles and doesn’t shut down cleanly under load. Inspect event-loop/runtime behavior, streams, workers, signals, module/runtime version, and resource cleanup.

We’re building UI in a custom retained-mode toolkit nobody here has used. Infer its component/layout/input/rendering model from the repo and implement the interface without forcing React/web assumptions onto it.
Implement browser login plus API authorization with OIDC/OAuth: choose the flow, PKCE/state/nonce, token audience/scope, refresh/logout behavior, callback validation, and provider-specific evidence.
We can’t tell why latency regresses until customers complain. Design useful SLIs/SLOs, traces, logs, metrics, alerting, dashboards, cardinality controls, and an operator drill-down path.
Use our service metrics and incident timeline to explain yesterday’s latency spike by region/version/dependency, quantify impact, and separate correlation from the operational evidence.
Add card payments and subscriptions with the provider API, including idempotent creation, webhooks, retries, failed-payment states, refunds, reconciliation, and sandbox verification.
The app got 4× slower after a change but we don’t know where. Reproduce under a representative workload, profile the bottleneck, test hypotheses, and prove the root cause before optimizing.
Build a repeatable load/benchmark test for this API with realistic traffic shape, warmup, concurrency, dataset, latency/throughput/error measures, and comparable runs.

We have a release candidate and a stated p95/throughput budget. Run the comparable measurements, verify correctness during load, and give a pass/fail performance gate with uncertainty and environment identity.
Modernize this PHP service’s typing, dependency boundaries, error handling, Composer/runtime assumptions, and tests while keeping framework behavior compatible.
Use plan mode to think through the migration first; don’t make changes yet.
Before editing anything, turn this ambiguous multi-part change into a concrete implementation plan with dependencies, unknowns, validation points, rollback risk, and an executable order.

We need a production-safe PostgreSQL schema/index migration. Check the installed version, lock behavior, transaction/DDL semantics, query plans, replication impact, rollback, and post-change verification.

We’re considering packaging this feature into paid tiers. Work through value metric, willingness-to-pay evidence, price/packaging options, unit economics, migration risk, and how we’d test monetization.
Map what personal data this feature collects and where it flows, then minimize it and design retention/deletion, consent/purpose, access boundaries, telemetry, and verifiable privacy controls.
Compare these three vendors for a real purchase decision: requirements, security/compliance evidence, integration/operations, contract/SLA, total cost, lock-in, references, and weighted tradeoffs.

Activation fell after the onboarding redesign. Define the product metrics/funnel, validate instrumentation, segment the cohorts, quantify the change, and identify what analysis can support a product decision.
We have five competing feature requests and limited engineering capacity. Turn customer/problem evidence into priorities, scope, success criteria, tradeoffs, and a decision-ready product brief.
This launch spans six teams with dependencies and a hard date. Build the execution plan, owners, milestones, critical path, risks, decision cadence, and escalation/communication system.

Our assistant gets worse as the conversation grows. Redesign what instructions/history/retrieval/tool output stay in context, how they’re ordered/compressed, and how we measure adherence versus token cost.
Fuzz this binary parser with generated malformed inputs, preserve shrinking/replay seeds, assert invariants, and compare against the reference implementation to catch semantic divergence.
Refactor this Python package’s typing, async/resource handling, packaging, exceptions, tests, and version-specific behavior without introducing a new framework.
Our RAG answers miss relevant policy passages. Reconstruct ingestion/chunking/metadata/filtering/retrieval/reranking/context assembly, then evaluate retrieval separately from generation.
Fix this React feature’s component/state boundaries, effects, rendering performance, accessibility hooks, async data interaction, and tests using the installed React version.
Build this Expo/React Native screen with native navigation, permissions, platform-specific behavior, offline/loading states, and device verification—not a browser-only React page.
Our collaborative editor needs WebSocket updates across reconnects. Design connection lifecycle, ordering, fan-out, presence, backpressure, replay/reconciliation, and fallback behavior.
The experiment already ended. Analyze treatment/control outcomes, uncertainty, guardrails, heterogeneous effects, and whether the evidence supports shipping.
This control loop must respond within a hard deadline every cycle. Analyze scheduling, clocks, jitter, priority inversion, blocking paths, worst-case timing, and how to prove the deadline on target.
Improve the home-feed recommender: candidate eligibility, logged exposure/click data, features, objective, ranking model, offline eval, online experiment, and feedback-loop risk.
This Redis-backed cache/queue needs a correctness review around key design, TTL/eviction, atomic updates, replication/failover, memory pressure, persistence, and recovery.
Restructure this module to remove duplication and clarify boundaries while preserving observable behavior. Prove equivalence with tests and avoid sneaking feature changes into the refactor.
Create a precise API/CLI reference for these commands and options: signatures, defaults, constraints, examples, errors, version notes, and cross-links. This is lookup material, not a tutorial.

Model orders, shipments, invoices, adjustments, and returns relationally. Define keys, constraints, normalization/denormalization choices, temporal rules, and migration implications before choosing indexes.
Plan how this risky change gets to production: versioning, rollout stages, compatibility, feature gates, observability, rollback, operator/customer communication, and release evidence.
Before signoff, prove the service meets its reliability claims under dependency failure, restart, partial outage, recovery, and sustained operation, with observable pass/fail evidence.

I just opened this repo and need to know how it actually works before touching anything: languages, package managers, build/test commands, services, generated files, local rules, and runtime assumptions.

Trace how authorization is implemented across this codebase: entry points, data flow, call sites, tests, config, historical compatibility clues, and where the actual policy decision lives. Don’t change it yet.
Investigate this question before recommending anything. Define what we need to know, gather trustworthy evidence, track uncertainty/conflicts, and synthesize only what the sources support.

Tune the mobile robot’s trajectory controller using the actual plant/sensor/actuator limits: reference frame, dynamics, estimator delay, saturation, stability, safety envelope, and hardware-in-loop evidence.
Refactor this Ruby service’s object boundaries, exceptions, concurrency/jobs, dependency management, tests, and version-specific behavior without changing the public contract.
This Rust crate has awkward ownership workarounds and unsafe code around an FFI boundary. Make the types/lifetimes/errors/concurrency sound and prove the safety contract.

A prospect wants a technical proof that our product fits their SSO, data-flow, security, and deployment constraints. Build the discovery/demo/POC plan and document gaps without inventing capabilities.
Design the lexical search/indexing side for a large product catalog: analyzers/tokenization, fields, filters, relevance, refresh/update behavior, synonyms, pagination, and evaluation queries.
Replace long-lived app secrets with a safer key/secret lifecycle: generation, storage, workload access, rotation, revocation, audit, break-glass, and recovery for the actual platform.
Harden username/password plus MFA login: credential storage, enumeration, throttling, recovery, session binding, step-up, device/risk signals, and failure UX. OAuth provider plumbing is not the task.
Do a bounded security review of this change: identify the trust boundaries and likely failure/abuse paths, inspect the evidence, prioritize concrete findings, and avoid broad claims you can’t prove.
The remediation is already implemented. Verify the claimed security fix against the original exploit/preconditions plus bypass and regression paths, and give a pass/fail verdict with evidence.

Move this bursty endpoint to a serverless runtime. Work through execution limits, cold starts, concurrency, statelessness, background work, network/storage connections, observability, and deployment behavior.
Fix this Bash/zsh automation so quoting, exit status, pipes, signals, temporary files, portability, and non-interactive behavior are correct—not just happy-path commands.

We can’t reproduce every hardware state on the bench. Build a simulator/HIL test matrix for sensor faults, timing, disconnects, malformed input, recovery, and equivalence checks against the real device.
Create or revise an agent skill for this recurring workflow, then test whether its description routes correctly and whether the same model actually performs better with it than without it.
Build the speech pipeline for noisy customer calls: capture/resampling, VAD/segmentation, transcription, speaker handling, latency, confidence/error cases, and evaluation on representative audio.

This offline app uses SQLite and sometimes reports database locked. Fix transaction/concurrency behavior, WAL/checkpointing, schema migration, constraints, backup/recovery, and version-specific assumptions.

Our tiny team is growing fast and basic operations are breaking. Set up a lightweight cadence for priorities, hiring/onboarding, cash/vendor visibility, ownership, recurring decisions, and operational risks.

Estimate the effect and uncertainty from this observational dataset. State the estimand/assumptions, choose an appropriate model, diagnose it, report intervals/sensitivity, and don’t imply causality without identification.
Design this event stream for out-of-order/late data: keys/partitions, event vs processing time, windows, watermarks, state, exactly-once/idempotent sinks, replay, and backpressure.

Harden our software supply chain from dependency selection through build and release: lock/provenance, CI identity, artifact signing/attestation, SBOM, secret exposure, tamper checks, and verified promotion.
This Svelte app has tangled reactive state and SSR/client mismatches. Refactor the components/state/data flow using the installed Svelte/SvelteKit behavior and verify hydration/runtime results.
Clean up this Swift library’s concurrency/Sendable boundaries, value/reference semantics, errors, package/API compatibility, and tests. It’s not a SwiftUI screen task.
The request mixes a React UI change, a payment webhook, and release verification. Pick the smallest correct set of specialist guidance instead of dragging every related skill into context.
Explain this architecture change to engineers who didn’t build it: what changed, why, constraints, interfaces, failure modes, evidence, and the few details they need to act correctly.

Design the user-facing CLI experience for this tool: command hierarchy, flags/stdin, TTY vs pipe output, progress, prompts, errors, exit codes, accessibility, and safe destructive flows. Shell implementation details are separate.

Refactor this Terraform stack without losing state: inspect backend/workspace/provider identity, use imports/moved blocks where needed, review the real plan, protect destructive changes, and verify convergence.

Design the test strategy for this change across unit/integration/end-to-end boundaries, choose the highest-value failure cases, keep tests deterministic, and make the suite prove behavior rather than implementation trivia.
Before implementation, threat-model this feature: assets, actors, trust boundaries, entry points, abuse cases, preconditions, mitigations, residual risk, and which assumptions need evidence.
The 3D scene has wrong transforms and frame-time spikes. Work through coordinate spaces, camera/projection, meshes/materials, GPU resources, culling, animation, and rendered/performance evidence.
Refactor this TypeScript package’s public types, module/runtime assumptions, async/error behavior, build output, compatibility, and tests without making it framework-specific.
Evaluate whether this workflow is usable for its intended users using a defensible study: tasks, participants, measures, observation, severity, evidence synthesis, and a retest plan.

We don’t understand why target customers abandon this problem today. Plan interviews/observation and recruitment, avoid leading questions, capture evidence, synthesize patterns, and separate needs from solution opinions.
Tune the vector index/search layer for millions of embeddings: distance metric, normalization, ANN index parameters, filters, update/delete consistency, recall/latency evaluation, and migration.

Don’t just say the change looks right—map each completion claim to something observable, run the relevant success and failure checks in the real environment, and report what is proven versus still unknown.
Turn these clips into a finished short video: story/edit structure, pacing, continuity, titles, audio sync/mix, color/output settings, and render/QC evidence for the target platform.
The interaction model is settled; now establish a strong visual direction for the app—hierarchy, spacing, typography, color, density, component treatment, responsive states, and rendered critique.

The UI implementation is done. Compare rendered states against the intended design across key viewport/device states, inspect layout/typography/color/focus/overflow differences, and document visual pass/fail evidence.
Fix this Vue app’s Composition API state, component boundaries, async behavior, SSR/hydration issue, and tests using the installed Vue stack.
Build this browser workflow with semantic HTML, keyboard/focus behavior, responsive layout, URL/history, loading/error/empty states, and real browser verification—don’t treat it as a native app.
Review the browser/HTTP security boundary for this feature: origin/CORS, cookies/session, CSRF, XSS/content injection, CSP, redirects, headers, caching, and actual browser/server behavior.

Make this webhook receiver production-safe: authenticate/signature-check raw payloads, handle replay/ordering/duplicates, acknowledge within provider limits, queue work, reconcile missed events, and test provider retries.
Rewrite this release memo in a dash free style. Preserve the literal --dry-run flag, quoted text, URLs, dates, quantities, uncertainty, and meaning while rephrasing ordinary prose naturally.
Explain the difference between em dashes, en dashes, hyphens, and minus signs. This is a punctuation explanation only; do not rewrite any prose.
